Added taskbar speaker mute/unmute control; preference persists independently in localStorage
AudioContext is unlocked by the first pointer or keyboard interaction for iPhone/Safari compatibility

Four new optional public-facing exploration hosts: EVAN-BOX, VANTA-WEB, COBALT-BBS, and ORCHID-NAS
Vanta Dynamics optional internal subnet with DEV-02, PRINT-07, and DB-01 reachable only through VANTA-WEB
Emergent leads can originate from MetroWire news, NightWire, FriendSpace, Messenger, and files found on optional hosts
Optional world intel is separated from formal case clues and never creates mission objectives
Free-exploration hosts do not auto-save to Saved Targets; players may bookmark them manually
Ambient scan remains usable for pure curiosity even before a hostname is identified
Messenger now supports multiple selectable friend threads including Sam and Chris
Cross-linked optional machines reward CLI/networking exploration without guaranteed mission rewards
News stories can now emit discovery events when technical details are deliberately opened
